status: Specified before any CSAFE handedness or identification outcomes; extension of the existing study, not a public preregistration.
eligibility: Original binary left/right survey labels; required source pages available; original feature-validity rules. Ambidextrous and missing handedness excluded before outcomes. No exclusion based on classifier performance.

cohort.selection: All 48 left-handed writers and 48 right-handed writers sampled without replacement from sorted IDs using numpy default_rng(20261108).
cohort.quality_failure_policy: Stop before evaluation and record missing/invalid required pages; no silent exclusion or result-driven replacement.

acquisition.gallery: Session 1, LND prompt, repetition 1 only; full page excluding provider-removed printed header.
acquisition.attribute_training: Session 1, LND and WOZ prompts, repetitions 1,2,3: six long-text pages per other writer. All pages of held-out writers excluded from attribute fitting and calibration. Short PHR pages not used.
query_conditions: S2_LND_r01: session 2, same prompt as gallery
S2_WOZ_r01: session 2, different prompt from gallery
S3_WOZ_r01: session 3, different prompt from gallery
acquisition.interpretation: Independent-dataset replication with within-dataset refitting. Different physical pages and capture sessions; no claim of cross-dataset transfer of a Bangla-trained classifier.

features.query_size: n=1 whole page; k=1 identity reference
features.deep_features: Same frozen torchvision ImageNet1K_V1 checkpoints and tile extraction as original; no fine-tuning.

sensitivity: hc183 adjusted for ink density and seven intensity summaries using fold-local residualization

features.validity: Shared original whole-image ink/STROKE finite-feature thresholds, applied before any performance analysis.

fitting.identity_scaling: StandardScaler fitted only on selected gallery LND reference page for each enrolled writer; L2 normalization and cosine similarity.
fitting.calibration: Five grouped writer folds for out-of-fold Platt logistic calibration; all preprocessing refitted inside each fold.
fitting.outer_test: Each query writer excluded from all auxiliary training/calibration pages and from temperature/weight targets.
fitting.development: Five writer folds regenerated inside each outer writer exclusion; each development attribute fit has its own five-fold grouped calibration and excludes the whole development validation fold.
fitting.temperature: 31 ID-only NLL grid values, logspace(-3,0), selected on other query writers for that query condition.
fitting.fusion_selection: NLL over other development query writers with fresh nested probabilities; fixed fusion has weight 1. Known gallery handedness is permitted metadata.

gallery_sensitivity: 20 seeded balanced 21/21 galleries from the selected 96-writer pool. Each refits its own primary HC183 auxiliary models. Evaluate both session-2 conditions; no independent-replication claim for overlapping galleries. The first is the designated size-matched descriptive gallery.
primary_tests: Eight: fixed/nested versus identity only for ResNet18 and ViT in the full 96-writer gallery, primary HC183 handedness, both session-2 conditions. Holm correction across all eight. All other representations, attribute-model variants, session-3 outcomes and subsamples are secondary descriptive analyses.
uncertainty: 10000 hand-stratified conditional writer-bootstrap draws and 9999 sign flips. Intervals retain fitted models and enrolled gallery. Report class-specific accuracy, attribute balanced accuracy, NLL/Brier, raw-score discrimination, temperature/weight selections, rescue/damage and filtering identity. Do not imply full-population or full-refitting uncertainty.
reporting: Retain all outcomes irrespective of whether handedness or identification accuracy improves. No external dataset selection on achieved accuracy. No manuscript changes or uploads before the experiment audit is complete.
